recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the Applied Jira resolution and fixes an implementation regression without expanding the approved semantic scope.
issue_request: FHIR-40496 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested that servers SHOULD check the fhirVersion MIME-type parameter as general processing guidance for the capabilities request, with ETag and 404 guidance separated rather than coupling the fhirVersion sentence to the 404 case.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#3442 was merged for FHIR-40496 and commit 08e2ca9544 moved the fhirVersion and ETag text into separate paragraphs in source/http.html. While doing so, it accidentally truncated the following 404 Not Found paragraph after 'not supported on the'.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2024-12-09 confirm the intended scope: checking the MIME type should be general to the capabilities request, and the MIME type and ETag statements should appear above the 404 sentence. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. source/http.html is the authoritative REST API source page for the capabilities interaction and is linked from the core module navigation.
reconciliation: Changed source/http.html to complete the 404 Not Found sentence with 'nominated service URL' while preserving the already-applied paragraph ordering for the fhirVersion MIME-type and ETag guidance.
source_changes: source/http.html: restored the missing phrase 'nominated service URL' at the end of the capabilities interaction 404 Not Found paragraph.

related_jiras.note: Discussed in the same FHIR-I meeting and visible in nearby HTTP history, but it concerns vread HEAD behavior rather than the capabilities interaction.
